title: Home Made Aimbot V2
features:
Entire rework of the Home Made Aimbot V1 the old one.  
It has esp tracers esp highlights, fly, speed hack, noclip, rainbow mode, inf jump, fullbright and RCs.
It also has an few new other things the old one didn't have. Not just  a few but an entire book more...
You can use sliders or directly write it inside if you click on the numbers.
I don't know if the trigger bot or auto shoot works well or even works in all games.

Tune it how you like it and so on

Keybinds
open menu: right ctrl
Default aimbot key: e
Default noclip key: n
Default fly key: f
